2607.25857.title: Shieldstral
2607.25857.paper_summary: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under one training framework. We present the data construction recipe, covering curation and generation of approximately 54.1M samples and a fine-grained evaluation set to evaluate policy adaptability. Together, these enable a small adaptive model to match or outperform much larger models.
2607.25857.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了 Shieldstral，一種具有 3B 參數的政策自適應多模態安全分類器，它在文本安全基準上與其大小近 7$\times$ 的模型相匹配或超越，並在多模態安全分類上設立了新的技術標杆。Shieldstral 將內容審核公式化為一個二元問題回答任務。這一簡單的公式化將多樣的審核任務統一為一個單一的是/否問題，使得具有不同分類法的異質安全數據集能夠在一個訓練框架下整合。我們展示了數據構建的配方，涵蓋了約 5410 萬樣本的策劃和生成，以及一個細緻的評估集來評估政策適應性。這些共同使得一個小型自適應模型能夠匹配或超越更大型的模型。
